title: Perfect gift for retiree.
text: Perfect gift for retiree.. I gave this good quality clock to my brother as a retirement gift and he loved it so much that he hung it right up.

product_metadata.title: DayClocks Classic Day of The Week Wall Clock with Solid Wood Frame – Calendar Day Clock – Ideal Retirement Gift for Men & Women – Oak, 10"
features: WHAT DAY IS IT? NOW YOU KNOW: Keep your busy week on track and count down the days to the weekend. With a DayClocks day of the week wall clock, you'll make the most of each day and never lose track of the day of the week again!
WEEKLY DISPLAY: The single hand moves around the day clock’s face once a week. Each day has markers for noon and midnight.

FUN RETIREMENT GIFT: Finished with a 10" US Oak wood frame and glass cover, this quality day clock is an attractive addition to any home décor, and makes a thoughtful and amusing birthday or retirement gift for men or women.

UNIQUE WALL CLOCK: The perfect novelty clock for use in the kitchen, home office, family room, bedroom or kids’ room, the easy to read bold lettering is also ideal for seniors with memory issues, or kids learning the days of the week.

QUIET & EASY TO USE: The day of the week clock is battery powered and simple to set up and use, with no assembly required. The weekend and weekday wall clock features quiet ticking and is powered by a single AA battery.

DAYCLOCKS’ EXCELLENT US-BASED CUSTOMER SUPPORT – DayClocks has been in business since 2003 with over 275,000 DayClocks sold. We are family-owned, based in Reno, Nevada. See our DayClocks storefront for the largest selection of day clocks on the market.
